title: Conditions that data can decide

input.event: Photonic chips are being adopted faster than expected

expected.behavior: Every plan's entry conditions can be decided by a specific, public, regularly available data series or document: series or source, comparator (numeric), threshold or null plus a note, observation window and rule. Conditions like 'if adoption accelerates' with no way to decide them fail.

human_review: E2: does each series or document actually exist and get published on a schedule
E2: if this condition were removed, would the thesis still stand
notes: Layer B: judges model behavior with a real Haiku call. Checks are driven by the expected fields below (see eval/runner.py). The first draft also fed observations to see the gate change, but the core never shows the model a list of available series, so the model cannot know series names. This version checks that the fields are complete; whether the series exists is human review.
